meta.title: Party · games for one table, on your phones

shelf.heading: What are we playing?
shelf.pitch: Party games for one table. Everyone plays on their own phone; a TV or laptop can show the table.

join.heading: Got a room code?
join.codeInvalid: A room code is 4 letters, like KWPF.
join.nameRequired: Put your name in, so the others know who's who.

start.phonesHint: Everyone plays on their own phone. No big screen needed.
start.nameRequired: Put your name in, so the others know who's who.
start.tableHeading: Or show the table on this screen
start.tableHint: For a TV or laptop everyone can see. Phones then show only their own cards.
start.openOnTable: Use this screen as the table
start.offline: Couldn't reach the room server. Check the connection and try again.
start.refused: The room server didn't take that. Try again.

room.qrLabel: QR code that opens this room
room.readOut: Read the letters out, or let them scan this.
room.seatsFor: {{max}} can play; anyone else watches until the next game.
room.goneHint: It may have closed after being quiet for a while. Start a new one.
room.endGameText: Everyone goes back to the room, and this game and its score are gone.
room.watchingGame: You're watching. You'll play in the next game.

errors.roomNotFound: There's no room with that code.
errors.notInRoom: This screen isn't in the room any more. Reload to join again.
errors.notSeated: Only players at the table can do that.
errors.tooFewPlayers: This game needs at least {{0}} players.
errors.cannotLeaveMidGame: You can't leave in the middle of a game. End the game first.
errors.badMessage: The room didn't understand that. Reload the page.
errors.badMove: That move doesn't exist in this game.
errors.badSettings: Those settings don't work for this game.
